function: Learns the RIS phase shifts that, with a closed-form ISAC transmit beamformer, maximize the sensing echo SNR under a communication SNR constraint (p. 3).
system: RIS-aided ISAC: BS with M=8 antennas senses one target and serves one single-antenna user; passive reflecting RIS with N=32 elements; frequency band not stated (p. 1, 4).
method: IBF-Net: lightweight CNN with depthwise-pointwise convolutions on image-shaped channel samples; unsupervised loss on sensing-communication channel correlation and sensing gain; Adam, 30 epochs (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Own Rician channels 'similar to [11]', stationary; 500,000 generated samples for training and 100 for testing; no 3GPP, public dataset or measurement (p. 4).
test_conditions: Training: 500,000 Rician samples; testing: 100 samples with the same settings (M=8, N=32, P=8 dBm, user SNR threshold 10 dB); N=16-80 and threshold 8 dB also evaluated (p. 4).
baselines: Non-learned only: 'AO' (alternating optimization with SDR [4]) and 'Rotation' (subspace rotation, gradient descent [7]); no learned baseline compared (p. 4).
metrics: Sensing (echo) SNR and communication SNR in dB, training loss, running time per sample in ms, and operation counts (p. 4-5).
complexity: Operations 1184N^2+576(N^2-N)+2048N^2log2N+6M, i.e. O(N^2+N^2log2N+M); runtime 3.7-5.2 ms per sample for N=16-80, versus AO 3.63e3-37.76e3 ms (p. 5).
q1_support: p. 4: "All channels are characterized as Rician channels similar to [11]". Custom Rician simulator; no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "100 samples are used to evaluate the generalization capability of the model". These are test samples of the same simulated setting; sweeps of N, threshold, power, alpha are separate configurations, no reuse of a trained model is stated.
q3_support: p. 4: "we compare it against two representative algorithms". Both are non-learned, AO [4] and Rotation [7]; no earlier learned method is compared on the performance metric.
q4_support: p. 5: "additions and multiplications operation number of the proposed network can be given as" 1184N^2+576(N^2-N)+2048N^2log2N+6M; order O(N^2+N^2log2N+M) and runtimes in Table II.
notes: Preprint arXiv:2403.17324v2. Area 5: beamforming in an RIS-aided ISAC system (the transmit beamformer is closed form, Theorem 1 on p. 2; the learned network designs the RIS phases). Rotation [7] is a gradient-descent method, not learned, so q3 = 0. The GitHub link was not opened. Sweeps of RIS size in Fig. 4 are not stated to reuse one trained model, and the network depends on N (p. 3).
